title: Swift 2S Turbo DNA Library Kit Protocol: Part 1/3 - Enzymatic Prep & Ligation
author: Opentrons (verified) Swift Biosciences
materials: can perform the [Swift 2S Turbo DNA Library Kit](https://swiftbiosci.com/swift-2s-turbo-dna-library-kits/). For more information about the Swift 2S Turbo Kit and the [Swift 2S Turbo Unique Dual Indexing Primer Kit](https://shop.opentrons.com/products/swift-2s-turbo-unique-dual-indexing-primer-kit-96-rxns?_pos=1&_sid=f1fb599e7&_ss=r) on the OT-2, please see our Application Note here: [Rapid high quality next generation sequencing library preparation with Swift 2S Turbo DNA Library Kits on the Opentrons OT-2](https://opentrons-landing-img.s3.amazonaws.com/bundles/swift_automated_ngs_application_note.pdf) In this part of the protocol, your OT-2 will complete the enzymatic prep portion and the initial steps of the ligation portion prior to adding your samples to a thermocycler, as described in the [Swift 2S Turbo Kit Guide](https://swiftbiosci.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/11/PRT-001-2S-Turbo-DNA-Library-Kit-Rev-1.pdf). At the completion of this step, you will add your samples to the thermocycler. Once the thermocycler step is complete, continue with [Part 2 of the protocol](https://protocols.opentrons.com/protocol/swift-2s-turbo-pt2). Links: * [Part
Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Replace K2 with DE
steps.instruction: Replace the Reagent K2 in the Enzymatic Prep Master Mix with Reagent DE to reduce the risk of over‑fragmentation.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Input your protocol parameters into the Opentrons software.

steps.title: Download protocol file
steps.instruction: Download the generated protocol file to your computer.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Upload the downloaded protocol into the Opentrons OT App.

steps.title: Set up deck layout
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate your labware, tip rack, and pipette using the OT App (refer to support articles for calibration tips).

steps.title: Start the run
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT App to begin the protocol.
